description: This Kotlin source file defines an OkHttp Interceptor implementation named AuthHeaderInterceptor, which attaches an Authorization header with a Bearer token to HTTP requests, if available. It reads the token from a TokenStore synchronously within the interceptor method using runBlocking.

classes.name: AuthHeaderInterceptor
classes.description: An OkHttp Interceptor that adds an Authorization header with a Bearer token to HTTP requests, unless the request URL starts with /auth/.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Method that intercepts the HTTP request, conditionally adds an Authorization header if a token exists, and proceeds with the request.
